blocks.content: Quiz: Which of these options best describes a linked list?

A fixed-size list where each element is kept in sorted order.
Linked lists have a dynamic size and do not require that their elements be stored in any particular order.
Linked lists have a dynamic size and do not require that their elements be stored in any particular order.
A dynamic data structure that grows and shrinks as needed.
This is a general description that could apply to several data structures.
This is a general description that could apply to several data structures.
A series of connected nodes, where each node stores data and the address of the next node.
This is the most accurate description of a linked list.
